name: Banana Washed
description: Classic Coffee introduces Burundi Washed Coffee. Post-Harvest the pulping and fermentation is done through a technique using leg wash, after which the beans are washed and dried with the combination of raised beds and patios. This method gives a very clean & balanced cup, with good body & acidity, and a long lasting caramel finish

name: Carbonic Maceration
description:
Classic Coffee introduces Carbonic Maceration Coffee.   
 Post harvesting, whole cherries are washed with clean water and kept in a carbonic maceration tank for fermentation with co2 gas, after which the cherries are dried. This method of fermentation, which drastically enhances the berry notes in the bean. 
 Roast Profile : Light to Medium

name: Cardamon
description: Nestled within the vast scape of the Western Ghats   in India, is the Malnad region of Karnataka, with its rich   heritage, culture and abundance of some   of India’s best coffee plantations. Situated in   Sakleshpur in the historic Munjarabad region, lies   HARLEY ESTATE dating back to the early 1860’s.   The plantation consists of crops such as Coffee,   Pepper, Cardamom, Cocoa, Bananas, Areca, Vanilla and Coconut. All crops are carefully planted in   between natural and jungle shade tress.

name: Citrus Reverie
description: Our newest specialty coffee is crafted from pulped Arabica beans, fermented for 24 hours in a citronella-based enzymatic solution. The beans are then carefully hand-washed to remove the mucilage and slowly dried to preserve clarity and character. The result is vibrant cup with layered complexity, delicate citrus nuances, and a refined aromatic finish.

name: Classic Wet Plum
description:
Classic Coffee introduces our new single-origin microlot from Harley Estate - Wet Plum Coffee 
 Whole ripe cherries are washed with clean water and then stored in an airtight container, for fermentation, along with the introduction of a plum bacteria developed in-house. Post which a slow drying method is adapted to allow the coffee to develop maximum flavours and thereby imparting flavours of a ripe juicy plum. 
   
 Roast Profile : Light to Medium

name: Classic Whisky Barrel-aged - Cold Brew Bags
description:
Our unique Whisky Barrel-aged coffee, which is aged in Amrut whisky barrels comes to you now in our cold brew bags. 
 Easy to use, aromatic, and intensely flavourful, the best cold beverage you could have!  
 Just steep your bag in 500ml of room temperature water for 12 to 16 hrs, in a cool place or in your refrigerator.  Remove the coffee bag, and enjoy your cold-brewed coffee over some ice. Couldn't get simpler than that!

  Enjoy the fragrance of Wine with the taste of coffee!  Roast Profile : Light to Medium

name: Golden Jack
description: Our newest specialty coffee is crafted from Arabica cherries fermented for 36 hours with a jackfruit-based starter culture. The cherries are then carefully dried on raised beds,allowing for slow,even moisture reduction and enhanced clarity. The result is a vibrant cup with layered sweetness, expressive fruit character, and a refined aromatic finish.

name: Golden Orchard
description: This specialty coffee is produced from whole coffee cherries fermented for 32 hours with a Barbodosa cherry extract and whey. The cherries are then carefully dried to stabilize the profile and preserve clarity. The cup presents layered complexity, enchaced sweetness, and refined aromatics with a distinctive fermentation character.

name: Grappa
description:
Classic coffee introduces Grappa Fermentation Coffee. Post-harvest, whole cherries are washed & then stored in an airtight container for formentation, along with the introduction of an in-house developed grappa bacteria, which eats the sugar content present & thereby imparting flavours of citrus, grape & jaggery.    
  Flavour Notes:   Jack Fruit (Biluva), Raisins, Fig, Sweet Citron & Brandy

name: Harley Estate Cascara
description:
Cascara which means "husk" or "peel" is the dried skin of coffee cherries. 
 At Harley Estate our Cascara is truly artisanal, we hand pulp the coffee cherries to retain juices of the cherry and increase the sweet fruitiness when the tea is brewed, our Cascara has hints of  Raw Mango, Lychee & Longan  
 Brewing Instructions : Add 2 or 3 grams of Cascara to 200ml of water (90-92 deg), let it steep for 2 mins, strain and enjoy. 
 Qty : 50Gms

name: Harley Estate Coffee Blossom Tea
description:
Just for a few days in a year the estate is filled with an intoxicating perfume and endless white of the coffee blossoms. In this quick period, the flowers are individually hand picked, dried and cured. Bringing you the most delicate and heady floral tea, with notes of jasmine, oolong and vanilla. 
 Brewing Instructions : Add 2 or 3 grams of coffee blossom to 220ml of water (90-92 deg), let it steep for 2 mins, strain and enjoy. 
 Tastes great, hot or cold. 
  Arabica coffee blossom flowers from Harley Estate.

name: Harley's Organic Rajamudi Rice

Harley's Organic Rajamudi Rice is rich in fiber, protein, magnesium, thiamine, calcium, and potassium. At Harley estate our  Rajamudi Rice  is truly artisanal, we take proper care in choosing seeds of the best quality. Much of the success in raising healthy seedlings based on the quality seed.
